Name: Nyapu Style Desert Expansion Laila
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[b][size=6]This Mod only works with the 1.0 version of the Desert Expansion Mod.[/size][/b]
[b]I just noticed recently that the modder removed Lalia from 2.0 of their mod. So if you want to use Lalia, you'll need to stick with version 1.0.2 or remove this mod. [/b]


I adore Nyapu's style portraits and custom NPCs. My passion project at the moment is to create Nyapu-style portraits for all the NPCs in my
mega-modded SDV file.

Merry Christmas, everyone! I am trying to chip away at my long to-do list. I figured I would do a large portrait retexture drop before the holiday. Enjoy!


[b]INSTALLATION (Must have Smapi):
[/b]
1. ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31595]Desert Expansion[/url]
2. ﻿Unzip and drag the replacement into your mods folder

[b]There are Three files:[/b]
[Main File] CP is just a drag and drop into your mods folder, and you're ready to go.

[Optional File Manual Replacement] The portrait replacement overwrites the portraits. Laila's Winter Portrait is not included.
You should get a prompt to replace the original files if you do it right.
If you need more guidance, Nyapu has a great example on their page. 

[Optional File Desert Expansion Dialogue Fixes] Fixes the dialogue bugs in the original mod. 
You should get a prompt to replace the original files. If not, the details of the files changed are below.


[i][b]EXTRA:
(Winter Outfit Added) 
[/b][/i][i]I noticed that Laila didn't have a winter outfit, and I thought it would be too cold for her to run around in a dress in the snow. So, I created a simple winter outfit for her. 

[b]IMPORTANT: (Dialogue Error Patch)[/b]
There were some code and dialogue errors for the English Desert Expansion Mod. I fixed the ones I found and created a patch for them. You will need to replace these manually.
The files that were fixed were: (9 json files)
Desert Expansion\[CP] Desert Expansion\data\Festival\FestivalDialogue\
Desert Expansion\[CP] Desert Expansion\assets\Characters\Laila

[i][b]IMPORTANT: (SVE Frontier Farm Fix Walkthrough Article)
If you have Frontier Farm you will need to fix some of the code so there aren't errors on the map. I wrote an article to help with that. [/b][/i][/i][b]
[/b][i]
[/i][b]
[/b][i][b]CREDITS:[/b]
BIG thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for letting me use their art as a base.
Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/197897369]HaruNesukts[/url] for allowing me to retexture their mod.
[b]
[i][b]What am I working on?:[/b][/i]
[/b][i]If you're curious what I am working on next, please check out my social media page or my Nexus profile. [/i][/i]
